proposal.name: Show sampled state coverage beside passing checks

plan.name: Show sampled state coverage beside passing checks
plan.summary: Complete #802 as one plumbing change: count distinct canonical states actually referenced by recorded trace visits, initial states or attempt endpoints, including unchanged attempts and repeated visits only once, excluding unused state-table entries, and compare that count only with the checked model's distinct reachable-state count at the same ratified bounds. Add a shared, evidence-derived coverage view and expose it as an additive coverage array in report and dashboard JSON, with one identified record per ordinary conformance result, Python invocation or component check (source, target/check/invocation where applicable, mode, integer states/model_states, checked, sampled, status, fraction and percent); use status partial/full/unknown, exact integer full-coverage comparisons, exact ungrouped fraction strings and percentages truncated to at most two decimal places without floating-point rounding or overflow, label successful incomplete or unknown coverage sampled, make failed checks and nonpositive, missing, conflicting or impossible counts explicitly unknown without a percentage, and never sum overlapping invocations, different models, larger-bound checks or replay evidence into a project share. Put sampled immediately beside those passing results in the Markdown headline and ordinary, Python and component conformance rows and in dashboard cards, grouped variants, tables and script-free evidence pages on both public and /act views, showing each applicable fraction and percentage or coverage unknown from shared evidence-derived rendering even for old JSON with stale assurance flags; preserve the coarse legacy Report.CodeAssurance/Claim categories, independently qualified proofs, full exhaustive receipt wording, every-state/every-step requirements, failed-attempt checks and overall gate failure, and do not promote a non-exhaustive full-state sample to proof, exhaustive exploration or transition/attempt coverage. Compute the new JSON/display metadata on detached views, ignore any serialized coverage claims in favor of original checked evidence, keep existing report and reader evidence fingerprints unchanged for unchanged archived evidence by excluding derived display metadata from their original encodings while continuing to bind the underlying checked counts, and change only existing assertions that pin an unqualified partial/unknown dashboard pass (enrich incomplete test fixtures when necessary without weakening proof or exhaustive assertions). Update SPEC.md with grounded decision citations and docs/gate.md with the exact coverage, JSON, rounding and qualification rules, and give README.md's explanation and gate table a short sampled-check qualification and link within its 400-line budget; the merger records #789's new display rule grounded in D-0024, D-0029, D-0043, D-0082, D-0088, D-0163, D-0170, D-0185, D-0122 and D-0294, while the build runs the affected Go suites, the installed-Chromium dashboard checks (including grouped/public/act/table coverage), documentation checks and existing PR CI integration and affected real Python/TLAPS lanes without changing CI or deferring those CI lanes to a follow-up.

tests.name: TestSampledCoverageCountsOnlyReferencedCanonicalStates802
tests.says: Both recording APIs count repeated canonical visits once and exclude unused state-table entries, while retaining initial states, unchanged attempt endpoints and the checked step counts.

tests.name: TestPartialSampleReceiptAndOldJSON802
tests.says: An old partial passing report renders sampled beside its headline and conformance result, exposes 2/5 and 40% in Markdown and JSON, and preserves evidence identity through rendering and JSON round trips while binding changed checked counts.

tests.name: TestCoverageBoundariesAndIndependentProof802
tests.says: Near-full and int64-scale fractions never round up to 100%, unknown totals cannot fabricate coverage, full sampled state coverage grants no exhaustive or proof claim, and independent proof, failed conformance and failed-attempt evidence retain their qualifications.

tests.name: TestPythonAndComponentCoverageStayPerInvocation802
tests.says: Python invocations and attributed component checks each retain their exact sampled share and identities in JSON and rendered receipt rows without aggregating overlap, unrelated models or larger-bound checks, trusting stale status flags or changing fingerprints on rendering.

tests.name: TestSampledCoverageDashboardAndEvidencePages802
tests.says: Dashboard JSON and served evidence HTML show exact coverage and sampled qualifications without mutating archived identities or overstating full samples; installed-browser checks exercise public and /act cards, grouped variants and tables.
